what: Speed of light, kqueue section of docs/v2/plan/lanes/core/speed-of-light.md: the kqueue file threads run threads.rs ReadAll as std::fs::read, which after reading the fstat size makes a 32-byte probe read to see the end (5 syscalls, bound 4; 5% of a 20 KiB read). Read into a Vec of capacity size + 1 and end at the first short read, as iocp/files.rs read_whole does; same bytes, one call less. Its test: files of 0, 1, 4096 and 65539 bytes, and a file grown between the stat and the read.
